svg.title: L1 sensor registry as pluggable substrate
svg.desc: Heterogeneous sensors plug into the registry which homogenizes their output into a uniform Signal type consumed by the rest of L1.

g.text: design-time commitment: a sensor must produce a Signal — that is the whole contract.
runtime freedom: any number of sensors can register. cloud VPS, container, raspberry pi all
use the same L1 with a different sensor mix.
